newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nearly half of Swedes want to leave EU - poll.
newsitem.headline: Nearly half of Swedes want to leave EU - poll.

text.p: Half of Swedes want to leave the European Union, according to an opinion poll published in the Gothenburg Post on Tuesday.
The survey by Sweden's Institute of Public Research Opinion (SIFO) found that 49 percent of those questioned wanted to leave the EU.
Sweden joined the EU in January 1995 after a referendum in November 1994 that just gave the move majority support.
The survey said 40 percent of Swedes wanted their country to stay in the EU -- a fall from 43 percent six months ago.
The poll found that manual workers were most opposed to the EU, with 61 percent wanting Sweden to end its membership.
Only 38 per cent of public servants and office workers were against EU membership.
